name: WhiteVPN Desktop
tagline: Cross-platform desktop VPN client built on mihomo
description: WhiteVPN-Desktop is a cross-platform desktop VPN client built with Wails and powered by the mihomo (Clash) engine. Wrapping the battle-tested mihomo core in a native desktop UI gives you a fast, configurable VPN experience across platforms without relying on a proprietary client. For self-hosters who want a controllable, open desktop VPN surface, it is a solid foundation.
highlights: Built with Wails on the mihomo (Clash) engine
Native desktop UI over a battle-tested core
curatorNote: Wrapping the mature mihomo core in a native Wails desktop app is a pragmatic way to get a controllable, cross-platform VPN client without building a proxy engine from scratch.
